metadata.description: MCP Agent Mail — coordinated multi-agent messaging. Ships the night monitor that delivers mail to an unattended Claude Code session, armed on demand by the bundled `wake` skill.

plugins.name: mcp-agent-mail
plugins.description: Night-time instant mail delivery for Claude Code. Declares a background monitor that streams Agent Mail hints for the life of the session, armed on demand by the bundled `wake` skill. Identity, credentials and message delivery still come from the lifecycle hooks installed by scripts/integrate_claude_code.sh; this plugin adds only the arming.
